_comment: Tests excluded from the LEAN profile's CLEAN/NOT-CLEAN verdict, ON TOP of the base tools/exclusions.json. Same policy as the base file: a test belongs here ONLY with a written justification, and the justification must tie it to a DOCUMENTED lean deviation (lean/README.md) or a proven environment/compiler limitation — never to an unfixed lean bug. Three entry forms: an exact transferred-file key; a key ending in '/' (prefix: prunes the whole subtree); a key starting 'glob:' (fnmatch on the full path). The denominator of the lean verdict is every transferred test not excluded here or in the base file.
utilities/memory/util.smartptr/util.smar: lean deviation: the atomic free-function family for shared_ptr (atomic_load/store/exchange/compare_exchange on shared_ptr) is omitted from the lean profile (deprecated in C++20; real lock-free shared_ptr atomics are out of scope for the target class). See lean/README.md smart-pointer deviations.
containers/container.node/: lean deviation: node_handle (extract/merge/insert(node_type)) is omitted from the lean associative containers — the rb-tree/hash nodes are malloc blocks without the allocator machinery node_handle's ownership transfer contract is specified in terms of. See lean/README.md container deviations.
utilities/utility/mem.res/: lean deviation: std::pmr (memory_resource, polymorphic_allocator, pmr containers) is not available in the lean profile — all storage is malloc/realloc/free. The base library keeps these; lean prunes them wholesale. See lean/README.md deviation 1.
